ItemID: 1; Title: HATCHBOX 1.75mm Orange PLA 3D Printer Filament, 1 KG Spool, Dimensional Accuracy +/- 0.03 mm, 3D Printing Filament; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have no current 3D printing project or established need for filament.
ItemID: 2; Title: Original Atmel Dip-8 ATTINY85-20PU Tiny85-20Pu Ic Chip Pack Of 5Pcs; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Small microcontrollers fit my breadboard and relay projects, and I would try these for a compact controller.
ItemID: 3; Title: KeeYees 3pcs BME280 Digital 5V Temperature Humidity Sensor Atmospheric Barometric Pressure Board IIC I2C Breakout for Arduino; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: These fit my Arduino prototyping interests and would give me a useful environmental sensing project.
ItemID: 4; Title: Seek Thermal CompactPRO – High Resolution Thermal Imaging Camera for Android USB-C,Black,Brown; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My infrared thermometer covers my current temperature checks, and I have no specific thermal imaging need.
ItemID: 5; Title: EDGELEC 100pcs 5mm White Lights LED Diodes Clear Round Lens 29mm Long Lead (DC 3V) +100pcs Resistors (for DC 6-12V) Included, Bright Bulb Lamps Light Emitting Diode; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: LEDs suit my electronics projects, but my earlier PCB kit already included LEDs, so I would pass this time.
ItemID: 6; Title: Multifunction Meter DIY kit, kuman Mega 328 Graphic transistor Tester, NPN PNP Diodes Triode Capacitor ESR SCR MOSFET Resistor Inductance LCD Display Checker with case and screwdriver K77; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: I would choose this to identify and check components while assembling breadboard and PCB projects.
ItemID: 7; Title: PerfectPrime TL3000, K-Type Thermocouple Racing Tyre Temperature Probe Pyrometers; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have no current racing tyre measurement project that calls for this specialized probe.
ItemID: 8; Title: DC Power Supply Adjustable (30V 10A), Eventek Variable Switching Regulated Digital Power Supply with Alligator Leads US Power Cord (30V 10A); ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Adjustable power would help with prototyping, but I would wait until a project requires this capacity.
ItemID: 9; Title: CHANZON 100 pcs 5mm RGB Multicolor Fast Blinking (Multi Color Changing) Dynamics LED Diode Lights (Flashing Round DC) Bright Lighting Bulb Lamps Electronics Components Flicker Light Emitting Diodes; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Automatic flashing effects do not serve a current project; I am more interested in practical circuit components.
ItemID: 10; Title: 625pcs Clear Heat Shrink Tubing Kit, Heat Shrink Tubes Wire Wrap, Ratio 2:1 Electrical Cable Sleeve Assortment with Storage Case for Long Lasting Insulation Protection by MILAPEAK (8 Sizes, Clear); ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would use the assorted sizes to insulate connections on battery holders, relays, and other wired projects.
